description: AMBIGUITY surfaced at stoagen arc sos--1ue close (NOMOS DIVERGENT, classified WRONG-SPEC; user-tier ruled accept-as-is, no history rewrite): 3 PLINY_stoagen-executed design commits carried only the harness model trailer, no seat-identity trailer. §28 as written targets CAPTAIN commits + pre-commit discipline at the WRITING seat (CAPTAIN_ADA.md §5.5); orchestrator-executed commits are arguably not covered. PROBLEM FOR THE SUBSTRATE TEAM: clarify the canon — (a) does the seat-trailer convention extend to orchestrator/MAJOR-executed commits? (b) if yes, who signs — the executing MAJOR or the writing CAPTAIN? (c) mechanical note from the incident: passing the trailer as a separate -m paragraph makes git's trailer parser keep only the LAST trailer block — whatever the ruling, the canon should carry the single-block gotcha. Reference: stoagen sos--1ue close ratification comment (2026-07-04) + NOMOS audit.
title: §28 seat-trailer canon: does the convention extend to orchestrator-executed commits (MAJOR seats), and who signs?
